column1: # KATHREIN KATHREIN Wallbox (Modbus TCP server) Modbus register map - easymodbus.com - source: https://community.symcon.de/uploads/short-url/cy0QLy5VdPIfO0xxbqwA4czIcnt.pdf

column7: Description
Version of this register mapping (currently 0x0001).
Article number text, format 620xxxxx(-yyyy).
Type text, format ACxx(E).
Serial number text, format G0Rxxxxxxx.
Power class, cable or socket, calibration-law version and relay capability.
column15: bit 0 = Power class bit 0 (0x0001 = 11 kW, 3 x 16 A); bit 1 = Power class bit 1 (0x0002 = 22 kW, 3 x 32 A); bit 4 = 0 = cable, 1 = socket (plug); bit 7 = 0 = standard, 1 = Eichrecht; bit 8 = Relay capability: L1 only; bit 9 = Relay capability: L2 only; bit 10 = Relay capability: L3 only; bit 12 = Relay capability: L1 and L2; bit 13 = Relay capability: L1 and L3; bit 14 = Relay capability: L2 and L3; bit 15 = Relay capability: L1, L2 and L3

column7: Phase rotation the wallbox is wired with.
column15: 0 = L1-L2-L3 (default); 1 = L1-L3-L2 (invalid phase rotation); 2 = L2-L3-L1; 3 = L2-L1-L3 (invalid phase rotation); 4 = L3-L1-L2; 5 = L3-L2-L1 (invalid phase rotation)

column7: Unix time: seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Charging session state.
column15: 0 = Idle; 1 = EV Connected; 2 = Authentication Waiting; 3 = Authentication Confirmed; 4 = Charging Active; 5 = Charging Paused; 6 = Charging Completed; 7 = RFID-Pairing; 65535 = Error

column7: Active fault flags; 0 = no error.
column15: bit 0 = Relay welded; bit 1 = Residual DC current detected (RCD); bit 2 = Socket lock detection; bit 3 = Charging overcurrent; bit 4 = CP-D: ventilation not available; bit 5 = CP-E: short circuit CP-PE; bit 6 = CP-F: loop broken CP-PE; bit 7 = PP error (short circuit); bit 15 = Internal error

column7: Plug version: cable rating from the PP resistor in amps; fixed-cable version reads 0.
column15: 0 = Cable not connected (socket version) / fixed cable mounted (cable version); 13 = 13 A (1500 ohm); 20 = 20 A (680 ohm); 32 = 32 A (220 ohm); 63 = 63 A (100 ohm); 65535 = Error (invalid PP resistor)

column7: Control pilot state; other values mean undefined or error.
column15: 0 = A (EV not detected, standby); 1 = B (EV detected); 2 = C (EV charging); 3 = D (EV charging with fan); 4 = E (CP short circuit); 5 = F (EVSE not available, CP = -12 VDC)

column7: Which line relays are closed; 0 = all off.
column15: bit 0 = Relay L1 activated; bit 1 = Relay L2 activated; bit 2 = Relay L3 activated

column7: Current per line signalled on the CP: 0 or 6000-32000 mA.
Power allowed over all active lines per the CP signal (1380-22080 W at 230 V).
Duration of the charging session.
Energy delivered in the charging session.
Write 0x8000 to hand control to the energy manager; default 0x0000 (off).
column15: 0 = EMS control disabled (default); 32768 = Enable EMS control

column7: Lines used with the current setpoint; L2 and L3 marked reserved for future. Default 0x0007.
column15: bit 0 = Line 1; bit 1 = Line 2 (reserved for future); bit 2 = Line 3 (reserved for future)

column7: 0 pauses, 6000-32000 mA charges, 0xFFFF cancels; default = power-class maximum.
0 = timeout off (default); each setpoint write restarts the timer.
Lines used after a timeout; default 0x0007 (3 lines).
column15: bit 0 = Line 1; bit 1 = Line 2; bit 2 = Line 3

column7: Current applied after a timeout: 0 or 6000-32000 mA, default 6000.
